findings.title: A label in a different language from its element
findings.message: The aria-label "Face ID" is read as ar.
findings.fix: Put lang on the element to match the label, or write the label in the language of the element.

findings.title: Spacing that does not mirror
findings.message: margin-left: 12px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end and the other logical properties.
